sloka: दिव्या पुण्य उदका रम्या हिमवंतम् उपाश्रिता ।लोकस्य हितकार्य अर्थम् प्रवृत्ता भगिनी मम ॥१-३४-९॥
transliteration: divyā puṇya udakā ramyā himavaṁtam upāśritā ।lokasya hitakārya artham pravṛttā bhaginī mama ॥1-34-9॥

translations.english: Conferring the benefit of the other world and worldly pleasures on men my sister Kausiki who is divine and beautiful having sacred waters took resort in Himavat mountain and started flowing from there.
